snippet.title: Missile Command Delta - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Missile Command Delta is launching on July 8th! You and your friends are trapped in a mysterious bunker and you must find your way out. Solve terminals, explore the twisting environments, and uncover the real story. 

Wishlist Missile Command Delta: https://urals.co/atari/missile-command-delta
